_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
A nye Player {player_id} le egbeleŋa LinesOfAction.
A ɛyaa si '{side}', ɛyaa putɛ si '{other}'.
Kɛlɛmɛyɔ kife: `[b1b3]` (ɛzɩ-coord ɛza-coord). Kɛlɛmɛyɔ sɔɔlɩm taa wɛʋ wɛʋ hɔɔlɩm tɛɛ cɩŋgaɩŋga, kɩɖɩɖɩ, kɩɖɩɖɩ yɔɔ cɩŋgaɩŋga tɛɛ pɩyɛɛ pɩyɛɛ kʋɖʋmɛɛ tɛɛ. A pɩzɩɣ a ɛyaa kʋɖʋmɛɛ a ɛyaa, pɩtɛɛ a ɛyaa putɛ; ɛzɩɣ a ɛyaa putɛ kɔɔ a ɛyaa. A ɖaŋɩ a ɛyaa tɩŋgaɩŋga ɛwɛɛ a ɛyaa 8-ɛyaa tɛɛ kʋɖʋmɛɛ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Pɩwɛɛ se pama-kʋ nɛ e2e4 (kpaɣnɩ, pɩkɔɔ piwolo coordonnées).
invalid_move.identical: Lone nɖɩ ɖɩ-taa palɩnaa yɔ nɛ ɖenɖe powoki yɔ, pɛwɛ kʋɖʋmʋm.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Pɩwɛɛ se pɔɖɔ nʋmɔʋ ŋgʋ kɩ-taa yaa patɩŋnɩ ɖasɩ yɔɔ.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Pɩwɛɛ se ɛɖɔ nʋmɔʋ ŋgʋ kɩ-ɖaɣlɩkɩŋ ɩnɩ, nɛ pɩla nɔɔ kʋɖʋmaɣ.
invalid_move.destination_own: Ɛ-maɣmaɣ ɛɖɔŋaɣna nɛ ewoki ɖenɖe ɛɛɖʋwa se ewolo yɔ.

game_action.captured_suffix: Player {player_id} kɛlɛmɛyɔ {from} -> {to} kɔɔ a ɛyaa putɛ.

outcome.win: Pɩtɩŋa pɩ-taa tɔm wɛ nɔɔ kʋɖʋmaɣ.
outcome.draw_no_capture: 60 taa lɛ, nɔɔyʋ tɩpɩzɩ nɛ ɛkpa-ɩ.
